outdoor-research-alti-ii-gore-tex-mitts.summary: Modular winter mitts with a GORE-TEX shell and removable insulated liner. Select your size and colour on Amazon.
outdoor-research-alti-ii-gore-tex-mitts.caution: No glove or mitt guarantees a safe exposure time in extreme cold.

hestra-army-leather-heli-ski-gloves.summary: Five-finger ski gloves with a leather palm and replaceable liner. Select your size and colour on Amazon.
hestra-army-leather-heli-ski-gloves.caution: These gloves are not waterproof; add protection in sustained wet conditions.

oakley-flight-deck-m-goggles.summary: Medium snow goggles with a Matte Black / Prizm Snow Sapphire Iridium option. The lens is intended for sun and clouds, not every blizzard or low-light situation.

smartwool-nts-250-balaclava.summary: Merino head and face coverage. The Amazon page describes the NTS AW15 250 in Black with 100% merino wool.
smartwool-nts-250-balaclava.caution: Merino knit is not waterproof; add weather protection as needed.

smartwool-thermal-merino-reversible-cuff.summary: The linked Amazon option is Mink Heather / One Size, sold as Merino Sport 250. A merino layer for a winter headwear kit.
smartwool-thermal-merino-reversible-cuff.caution: Merino knit is not a waterproof shell.

therm-a-rest-neoair-xtherm-nxt-review.summary: Regular Wide / Neptune sleeping pad with R-value 7.3 and a documented weight of 540 g. An insulated ground layer for a winter sleep system.
therm-a-rest-neoair-xtherm-nxt-review.caution: Amazon warning: Do not use below −20 °C. R-value is not a safe air-temperature rating.

kahtoola-microspikes.summary: Stretch-on traction for winter footwear. Select the correct fit for your shoes or boots on Amazon.
kahtoola-microspikes.caution: The boots shown in the cinematic image are not included. MICROspikes are not a substitute for technical mountaineering crampons.

darn-tough-hunter-boot-socks.summary: Hunter Boot socks for a winter footwear kit. Check the selected size and colour on Amazon.
darn-tough-hunter-boot-socks.caution: Check sock and boot fit together; avoid compression that restricts circulation.

smartwool-merino-250-base-layer.summary: A long-sleeve merino crew for a winter layering system. Confirm the selected size and colour on Amazon.
smartwool-merino-250-base-layer.caution: A base layer is not a weatherproof outer shell; add protection for the conditions.

therm-a-rest-polar-ranger-sleeping-bag.summary: A down sleeping bag for a winter sleep system. Confirm the selected length and current model on Amazon.
therm-a-rest-polar-ranger-sleeping-bag.caution: A sleeping bag alone does not guarantee safety in extreme cold; plan ground insulation and shelter.

baffin-impact-winter-boots.summary: Winter boots with removable inner insulation. Confirm the selected size and colour on Amazon.
baffin-impact-winter-boots.caution: Waterproof-base construction does not mean the entire boot is waterproof.
